commands: kubectl get pods -n fleetcast -o wide && kubectl get events -n fleetcast --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -40
kubectl logs -n fleetcast -l app.kubernetes.io/component=backend --tail=80; kubectl logs -n fleetcast locust-fetcher --tail=40
kubectl logs -n fleetcast -l app=satellite-app-backend --tail=65; kubectl get pod locust-fetcher -n fleetcast -o yaml

kubectl exec -n fleetcast deploy/fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend -- cat /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf; kubectl exec -n fleetcast deploy/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- sh -c 'ls /app; printenv | sort'

kubectl get all,ingress -n fleetcast; ls -la /tmp; kubectl exec -n fleetcast locust-fetcher -- python -c 'import urllib.request; print(urllib.request.urlopen("http://fleetcast-satellite-app-backend:5000/api/dashboard").read())'
kubectl get secrets -n fleetcast; kubectl get ingress -n fleetcast -o yaml; kubectl get events -n fleetcast --field-selector type=Warning; which helm; ls /

kubectl get secret sh.helm.release.v1.fleetcast.v1 -n fleetcast -o jsonpath='{.data.release}' | base64 -d | base64 -d | gzip -d > /tmp/fleetcast-release.json
python - <<'PY'
import json
r=json.load(open('/tmp/fleetcast-release.json'))
print(r['manifest'])
print('VALUES',r.get('config'))
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
r=json.load(open('/tmp/fleetcast-release.json'))
print(r['manifest'])
print('VALUES',r.get('config'))
PY

kubectl exec -n fleetcast locust-fetcher -- python -c 'import socket; names=["load-generator.default.svc.cluster.local","load-generator.fleetcast.svc.cluster.local"]; [(print(n, socket.getaddrinfo(n,8089)) if False else None) for n in []]; exec("for n in names:\n try: print(n,socket.gethostbyname(n))\n except Exception as e: print(n,str(e))")'

cat > /tmp/fleetcast-load-generator.yaml <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: load-generator-locustfile
  namespace: fleetcast
data:
  locustfile.py: |
    from locust import HttpUser, task, between

    class FleetCastUser(HttpUser):
        wait_time = between(1, 3)

        @task(3)
        def dashboard(self):
            self.client.get('/api/dashboard')

        @task
        def station(self):
            self.client.get('/api/station/GS-1', name='/api/station/[station_id]')

        @task
        def health(self):
            self.client.get('/api/health')
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: load-generator
  namespace: fleetcast
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: load-generator
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: load-generator
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: locust
          image: locustio/locust:2.31.8
          args:
            - -f
            - /mnt/locust/locustfile.py
            - --host=http://fleetcast-satellite-app-backend:5000
            - --autostart
            - --users=2
            - --spawn-rate=1
            - --web-host=0.0.0.0
          ports:
            - name: web
              containerPort: 8089
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /stats/requests
              port: web
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: locustfile
              mountPath: /mnt/locust
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: locustfile
          configMap:
            name: load-generator-locustfile
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: load-generator
  namespace: fleetcast
spec:
  selector:
    app: load-generator
  ports:
    - name: web
      port: 8089
      targetPort: web
EOF
kubectl apply -f /tmp/fleetcast-load-generator.yaml
kubectl rollout status deployment/load-generator -n fleetcast --timeout=120s
kubectl get pods -n fleetcast; kubectl logs -n fleetcast -l app=load-generator --tail=15
kubectl logs -n fleetcast -l app=load-generator --tail=20; kubectl logs -n fleetcast locust-fetcher --tail=6

kubectl exec -n fleetcast locust-fetcher -- python -c 'import json,urllib.request; d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://load-generator:8089/stats/requests",timeout=10)); print(json.dumps({k:d[k] for k in ["state","user_count","total_rps","fail_ratio","errors"]})); print(json.dumps(d["stats"]))'; kubectl get deployments -n fleetcast; kubectl logs -n fleetcast locust-fetcher --tail=2
